figurative_meaning_en: A person who creates obstacles or trouble everywhere
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা মুখপোড়া বাঁদর, সবসময় আমাদের পরিকল্পনা নষ্ট করে দেয়।
অফিসে মুখপোড়া বাঁদরের মতো আচরণ করলে কাজ এগোবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real troublemaker, always spoiling our plans everywhere.
Acting like a mischief-maker at the office won't get any work done.
history: This idiom draws from the Ramayana epic, where Hanuman, the monkey god, sets Lanka ablaze with his burning tail, symbolizing disruption; 'মুখপোড়া' metaphorically refers to the fiery mischief associated with him.
note: Synonymous idiom: লঙ্কাপোড়া (Lanka-burnt, referring to the same mythological event)
